description.value: The white mage exercises caution when in danger, casting her spells with more care. While in a threatened square, she may choose to spend a full-round action to cast a spell, with a casting time of standard action or less. Doing so allows her to cast the spell without needing to cast defensively. Prerequisite: The white mage must have the Combat Casting feat to select this talent.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Mage Talents)
